title: Affine consistency tester
statement: For each positive natural number $n$, define a nonadaptive tester with three queries, using a uniformly random seed consisting of a coordinate $i$ and a length-$n$ binary-cube vector $y$. It queries the input bit at coordinate $i$, and the truth-table entries indexed by $y$ and by $y+e_i$, where $e_i$ is the standard basis vector at coordinate $i$. It applies the affine consistency transcript predicate to the answers.
hypotheses_covered: A natural number n that is nonzero
